name: JREキャンペーンbot
tagline: Registers you for every open JRE POINT campaign so none slip past
description: Japan's JRE POINT programme runs a rotating set of regional offers, and most of them only pay out if you opt in before the window shuts. Using your own signed-in account, this one walks whatever is currently open across the regions you pick and registers you for each, so points you already earn are not left behind.
author: countertek
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
